lesson: gemma-4-12B-coder GGUF returns special tokens <unused30> instead of code (eval_count=4) - do not dispatch to this model, use qwen3:latest
do not accumulate floating point in a loop (time += dt drifts) - compute each point as index*step instead
acceptance examples with computable numbers (10 chars / 14 = 0.714 + 0.30) make the model match the formula exactly - always show the arithmetic
small models may drop the export keyword from the signature - the file then compiles but exports nothing; verify gate must call the exported symbol
sushirl and Qwythos emit untagged chain-of-thought that restates the prompt (including ``` sequences) - extract the LAST fence containing export function, never the first fence
when parsing timecode strings MM:SS.mmm the seconds field must be validated 00-59 - reject 00:60.000 as invalid
String.padStart is an instance method not static - String.padStart(n,2,'0') is a syntax hallucination; use String(n).padStart(2,'0')
injecting past-mistake lines that are NOT semantically related to the task lowers pass-rate (57% vs 100% measured) - inject only semantically matched lessons or none
sushirl 9B passes 7/7 at temp 0.1 with extractor v2 (last fence containing export function) - best co-resident model, 5.57GB VRAM
Qwythos model card forbids temperature <= 0.3 (repetition loops) - use temp 0.6 top_p 0.95 top_k 20 repeat_penalty 1.05; never reuse one config across models
plain prompt with computable acceptance makes qwen3 emit an empty think block (~5s/task); bracket section headers trigger 10x longer chain-of-thought and num_predict overflow failures
Mellum2 MoE passes 6/7 at card settings (temp 0.6) - generates 127 tok/s (4x qwen3), cold load 26.8s, VRAM 8.25GB; broken GGUF is per-build not per-uploader
timecode format MM:SS.mmm has a DOT before milliseconds - models slip to MM:SS:mmm in regex; acceptance must include a case that distinguishes the separator
Ornith 9B: code 6/7 + tool-use 3/3 (fastest 1.9-2.7s) at temp 0.6, VRAM 5.57GB - best all-rounder for agentic dispatch co-resident with ML jobs
gemma-agentic-v2: tool-use 3/3 but code only 3/7 - dispatch tool-calling tasks only, never code generation; v2 GGUF fixed (no special-token leak unlike coder v1)
qwen3 with tools array on /api/chat enters a think-loop and times out beyond 900s - do NOT use qwen3 for tool-calling dispatch; use Ornith or gemma-agentic-v2

all 106 Ollama blobs on C: are 0KB symlinks to G:\.ollama_blobs_root (GHT offload) and G: is a 1TB HDD ~100-150MB/s - cold-load bottleneck is the HDD not the SSD; hot-tier frequently-used models back onto C: SSD (~12GB set) to cut cold from ~56s to ~11-15s

always audit sampling config against each model card BEFORE benchmarking - qwen3 tag had temperature 0.1 baked into its Modelfile while Qwen officially requires 0.6/0.95/20/min_p 0 and warns greedy decoding causes endless repetitions; misconfig nearly got models wrongly blacklisted (Qwythos 1/7 vs 5/7, qwen3 tools timeout)

sushirl = hf.co/bigatuna/Qwen3.5-9b-Sushi-Coder-RL-GGUF (RL-coding via hermes-agent/atropos) - card explicitly sanctions deterministic inference (temp 0.0-0.6), which is why it tolerates low temp unlike qwen3; multimodal export (pair with mmproj if vision needed)

gemma-coder v1 card errata: early GGUF exports were broken and re-download gets updated quants - our blacklisted copy (5434f64afb3f, pulled 2026-06-25) was the bad export; blacklist applies to that build, re-pull may fix; card itself recommends v2 for agentic use
